_metadata.description: Seasonal weather shock profiles and hazard weights for FarmWise simulator

sources.temperature_stress: ICAR-CRIDA (Central Research Institute for Dryland Agriculture) Agromet advisories
sources.weather_anomalies: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Agricultural Meteorology Division guidelines

prototype_assumptions: Discrete aggregate seasonal modifiers approximating cumulative thermal and precipitation shocks
Sub-risk hazard scores (0-100) calibrated for composite agricultural risk formula

optimal.name: Optimal / Highly Favorable
optimal.description: Ideal diurnal temperature range and solar radiation during grain/pod fill; regular well-distributed showers

normal.name: Normal / Seasonal Average
normal.description: Standard historical agro-meteorological conditions for the region and season

moderate_heatwave.name: Moderate Heatwave / Dry Spell
moderate_heatwave.description: 2-4°C above normal during sensitive reproductive stages (anthesis/silking) or a 15-day dry break

severe_drought.name: Severe Drought / Heat Shock
severe_drought.description: Prolonged monsoon failure or extreme temperatures (>4°C anomaly) causing acute vapor pressure deficit and terminal stress

unseasonal_rain.name: Unseasonal Heavy Rain / Hail
unseasonal_rain.description: Excess rainfall, cyclonic depressions, or hail during flowering or pre-harvest ripening causing lodging and fungal rot
